sentences.en: The new mayor is well spoken of by the citizens.
sentences.zh: 新市长受到了市民们的高度赞扬。

sentences.en: The mayor compromised on the subject to a certain extent.
sentences.zh: 市长在该问题上做出了一定程度上的妥协。

sentences.en: The mayor presented him with the key to the city.
sentences.zh: 市长将这座城市的钥匙交给了他。

senses.zh: 市长,镇长,（英格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰由议员选举产生的）镇长,（民选的）市长
